preregistration_nature: fixed code parameters before this CI run, BUT hypotheses motivated by previously observed B and C2 losses; NOT an independent preregistered untouched sample

fiscal_uncertainty_band.definition: Reject only materially adverse D+3 TGA forecast exceeding rolling 120 previously settled and released D+3 absolute-error mean (>=30 samples). Neutral inside band.

revision_adverse_only.definition: Reject ONLY if previous published MODEL D+3 same-target revision Z >= +0.75 adverse to gold side; missing significant Z is neutral, but prior uncertainty estimate required.

revision_positive_only.definition: Positive-control select-only: trade if revised D+3 forecast Z <= -0.75 favorable for gold direction. Missing revision means NO trade, never assume favorable.

reserve_transmission_gap.definition: Reject if predicted favorable D+3 TGA change exceeds prior model error AND 28-calendar-day bank reserve trend runs against intended gold direction. Historical regime diagnostic not a 3-day reserve forecast.

gold_prepriced_3atr.definition: Reject entries after gold has already moved >=3 completed 4h ATRs in same direction over previous 15 completed 4h bars. Price-based prepricing EXHAUSTION proxy, not proven priced-in fraction.

fiscal_plus_transmission.definition: Reject materially adverse fiscal projection OR expected materially favorable fiscal projection contradicted by past reserves trend.

all_four_combined.definition: All above vetoes, except positive-revision-only requirement; shortage of strong favorable Z does not block a trend trade. All safeguards fixed before study.

common_risk_costs.gold: Yahoo continuous GC=F hourly to five-slot 4h New York evening sessions
common_risk_costs.A_exposure: 1x gold long fully invested from start to end (no leverage/rebalancing)
common_risk_costs.B_exposure: Cash unless strict confirmed Dow daily AND weekly swing trend equals 4h breakout; 0.5pct risk / trade, 5x cap

completeness_limitations: SAME pre-examined 2025-2026 sample: all 7 methods exploratory; no out-of-sample proof or validated profits
Rolling uncertainty bandwidth uses PREVIOUS settled TGA and conservative historical lag, but fiscal source as-published vintages are unverified
Prior 120 D+3 model absolute errors averaged only when at least 30 settled; MAE neutral band NOT a confidence interval
Predicted TGA is not market consensus and includes gross-bill issuance imputation, TreasuryDirect Net New Cash and coupon redemption gaps
Past 28-day bank reserves and past ON RRP changes are regime context only, NOT estimated next 3-day balance sheet changes
Gold >3 ATR already advanced over 15 fully closed prior 4h bars is only a price-exhaustion proxy, not actual measured market absorption
Event selection after earlier B and C2 research means method comparison is hypothesis generation, no selection-adjusted p-value
Trade entry/exit simulated using Yahoo GC=F continuous future 4h bars (not independently reconciled COMEX contract rolls or real execution)
As-of lagged current-vintage macro source levels are not certified real-time vintage; CFTC shutdown deferred releases were accounted for
All model methods filter B price candidates and do NOT exhaust alternative macro-led entry timing or pure fiscal shock trades
Use all methods including those returning zero trades; do not cherry pick strongest in-sample method
